name: visitor-pass-management-system
description: MERN Visitor Pass Management System with QR passes, PDF badges, OTP verification, multi-org support, and Docker + Nginx deployment.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev:memory: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev:memory'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
